title: 微软交付计划：怎样解释里程碑和依赖关系
topic: 微软交付计划：怎样解释里程碑和依赖关系

source.title: Delivery Plan - Engineering Fundamentals Playbook
source.license: 原文按项目方确认的授权收录
source.context: 原文出自 Microsoft 微软 公开资料。
paragraphs: While Scrum does not require and discourages planning more than one sprint at a time. Most of us work in enterprises where we are dependent outside teams (for example: marketing, sales, support).

A rough assessment of the planned project scope is achievable within a reasonable time frame and resources. The goal is to have a rough plan and estimate as a starting point, not to implement "Agilefall."
Note that this is just a starting point to enable planning discussions. We expect the actual schedule to evolve and shift over time and that you will update the scope and timeline as you progress.
As you complete the assessment, you can push back on the scope, time frame or ask for more resources.
As you progress in your project/product delivery, you can highlight risks to the scope, time frame, and resources.
translations: Scrum 不要求一次规划超过一个冲刺，也不鼓励这样做。我们许多人在企业中工作，工作依赖其他团队（例如市场、销售和支持团队）。
可以在合理的时间和资源范围内，对计划中的项目范围做粗略评估。目标是把粗略计划和估算作为起点，而不是搞“敏捷瀑布”。
这只是启动规划讨论的起点。实际日程预计会随着项目推进而变化；你也会逐步更新范围和时间表。
完成评估后，你可以对项目范围和时间安排提出异议，或申请更多资源。
随着项目/产品交付推进，你可以指出范围、时间安排和资源方面的风险。
fullTextParagraphs: While Scrum does not require and discourages planning more than one sprint at a time. Most of us work in enterprises where we are dependent outside teams (for example: marketing, sales, support).

A rough assessment of the planned project scope is achievable within a reasonable time frame and resources. The goal is to have a rough plan and estimate as a starting point, not to implement "Agilefall."
Note that this is just a starting point to enable planning discussions. We expect the actual schedule to evolve and shift over time and that you will update the scope and timeline as you progress.
Delivery Plans ensure your teams are aligning with your organizational goals.
As you complete the assessment, you can push back on the scope, time frame or ask for more resources.
As you progress in your project/product delivery, you can highlight risks to the scope, time frame, and resources.
One approach you can take to accomplish is with stickies and a spreadsheet.
Stack rank the features for everything in your backlog
Functional Features
Non-functional Features
User Research and Design
Testing
Documentation
Knowledge Transfer/Support Processes

T-Shirt Features in terms of working weeks per person. In some scenarios, you have no idea how complex the work. In this situation, you can ask for time to conduct a spike (timebox the effort so you can get back on time).

Calculate the capacity for the team based on the number of weeks person with his/her start and end date and minus holidays, vacation, conferences, training, and onboarding days. Also, minus time if the person is also working on defects and support.
Based on your capacity, you know have the options
Ask for more resources. Caution: onboarding new resources take time.

Reduce the scope to the most MVP. Caution: as you trim more of the scope, it might not be valuable anymore to the customer. Consider a cupcake which is everything you need. You don't want to skim off the frosting.
Ask for more time. Usually, this is the most flexible, but if there is a marketing date that you need to hit, this might be as flexible.
You can also leverage one of these tools by creating your epics and features and add the weeks estimates.

The Plans (Preview) feature on Azure DevOps will help you make a plan. Delivery Plans provide a schedule of stories or features your team plan to deliver. Delivery Plans show the scheduled work items by a sprint (iteration path) of selected teams against a calendar view.

Confluence JIRA, Trello, Rally, Asana, Basecamp, and GitHub Issues are other similar tools in the market (some are free, others you pay a monthly fee, or you can install on-prem) that you can leverage.

notes.explain: 源文的 dependent outside teams 搭配不自然；更自然的是 depend on other teams。outside teams 指团队之外的其他团队，不一定在组织之外。
notes.example: The portal project depends on another team for API integration.

notes.explain: 这是初步估算，先判断范围、时间和资源大致是否可行；它不是精确承诺。
notes.example: We need a rough assessment before we discuss milestone dates.

notes.explain: 源文以 While 从句和句号结束，单独看是不完整句子；后文 Most of us... 才是主句。不要只照抄这一句。
notes.example: While Scrum focuses on one sprint at a time, teams can still discuss a rough longer-term plan.

notes.phrase: achievable within a reasonable time frame and resources
notes.meaning: 在合理时间与资源范围内可行
notes.explain: 这句源文把 assessment 说成 achievable，结构不够自然；更清楚的表达是 assess whether the scope is achievable with reasonable time and resources。
notes.example: We can assess whether the scope is achievable with the available time and resources.

notes.meaning: 用 T 恤尺码估算功能工作量
notes.explain: 这是用 S/M/L 等相对大小进行粗估的比喻，不是要求按字面工作周数精确换算。源文说法不够清楚，团队需另行约定估算尺度。
notes.example: Let’s use T-shirt sizes for an initial estimate, then refine the work.

notes.explain: 源文这里把 now 拼成了 know。自然写法是 Based on your capacity, you now have the following options。
notes.example: Based on our capacity, we now have a few options.

notes.explain: the most MVP 不是自然表达。可说 reduce the scope to a minimum viable product (MVP)；MVP 是产品范围，不是可直接比较的形容词。
notes.example: We can reduce the scope to a minimum viable product.

notes.explain: 结合前文语义，源文很可能漏了 not；按现有文字它会说“可能同样灵活”，但市场日期通常会限制可调整时间。自然表达是 it may not be as flexible。
notes.example: If we have to meet a marketing date, asking for more time may not be as flexible.

notes.explain: 原文此处搭配不自然；可以说 add weekly estimates 或 add estimates in weeks。
notes.example: Add the estimates in weeks to the delivery plan.

notes.explain: 原文建议先把待办中的功能排序，之后再估算团队产能；没有规定只能按业务影响排序。
notes.example: Let’s stack-rank the features before we estimate the delivery plan.

scenario.title: 客户门户交付计划与 API 依赖
english: Sarah is preparing a delivery plan for a new customer portal. The team can begin the content and interface work now, but final integration depends on an API from a partner team.
Her director asks for a firm release date. The API team has not confirmed its delivery date, so the team can estimate some work but cannot yet confirm the final integration milestone.
Sarah replies, "We can make a rough plan based on what we know and mark API delivery as an open dependency. Once the API team confirms a date, we can update the milestone dates."
chinese: 莎拉正在为一个新客户门户制定交付计划。团队现在可以开始内容和界面工作，但最终集成依赖合作团队提供的 API。
她的主管要求给出确定的上线日期。API 团队尚未确认交付时间，因此团队可以估算部分工作，但还不能确认最终集成里程碑。
莎拉回答：“我们可以根据目前掌握的信息做一个粗略计划，并把 API 交付标记为尚未确定的依赖项。API 团队确认日期后，我们就能更新里程碑日期。”

firstAttempt.prompt: 客户门户功能依赖外部 API 团队交付，但对方还没有确认日期。请用英文提出先根据已知信息做粗略计划、标记开放依赖，并在拿到日期后更新里程碑；不要把粗略日期说成承诺。
firstAttempt.sample: Let’s make a rough plan based on what we know; it is not a firm delivery-date commitment. Let’s mark API delivery as an open dependency. Once the API team confirms a date, we can update the milestone dates.
firstAttempt.rationale: 微软指南把粗略计划和估算作为讨论起点，并预期日程会随项目进展调整。API 团队和具体依赖是虚构练习情境。

words.example: Let’s start with a rough plan and update it as we learn more.
words.translation: 我们先做一个粗略计划，了解更多信息后再更新。
words.note: 当前估算供讨论起步，不代表最终承诺。

words.collocation: a rough estimate of the scope
words.example: This estimate is a starting point, not a final commitment.
words.translation: 这份估算是讨论起点，不是最终承诺。
words.note: 名词重音在第一个音节；动词 estimate 的重音不同。

words.example: The API delivery is an open dependency.
words.translation: API 交付是一项尚未确定的依赖。
words.note: 计划中还有一项外部信息或交付尚未确定。

words.example: We can update the milestone dates when the API date is confirmed.
words.translation: API 日期确认后，我们可以更新里程碑日期。
words.note: 本课用于说明预计完成节点会随依赖信息变化。

words.example: We can revisit the time frame after the partner team responds.
words.translation: 合作团队回复后，我们可以重新评估时间范围。
words.note: 表示计划预计占用的时间区间。

words.meaning: 可投入的工作量；团队产能
words.example: Our capacity may change if support work increases.
words.translation: 如果支持工作增加，我们的团队产能可能会变化。
words.note: 可用于估算团队在给定时间内能承担多少工作。

structure.original: The goal is to have a rough plan and estimate as a starting point, not to implement "Agilefall."
analysis: 主句核心是 The goal is to have…；to have a rough plan and estimate 是说明目标内容的不定式。
as a starting point 表示粗略计划的用途是启动讨论，不是给出固定承诺。
not to implement… 表示排除的目标。Agilefall 是源文使用的非正式组合词，不是本课要记的标准术语。
structure.transfer: The goal is to give the team a useful forecast, not to promise an exact date before the dependency is clear.

rewrite.bad: The director asked for a plan, so we should commit to the current milestone dates even though the API timing is unknown.
rewrite.good: Let’s put together a rough schedule for the design work and mark API integration as an open dependency. When the partner team confirms its date, we can update the release milestones.
rewrite.translation: 我们先为设计工作拟一个粗略时间表，并把 API 集成标记为尚未确定的依赖项。合作团队确认日期后，我们可以更新发布里程碑。
rewrite.pattern: We can share [a rough plan], mark [the dependency], and update [the milestone dates] when [the information arrives].

cloze.prompt: Use the adjective from the word card: Let’s make a ___ plan based on what we know.
cloze.why: rough 表示初步、大致；它说明当前计划供讨论起步。

cloze.prompt: Complete the exact task phrase: Mark API delivery as an open ___.
cloze.why: dependency 是需要等待或确认的依赖项。

cloze.prompt: Complete the exact task phrase: update the milestone ___.
cloze.why: 根据依赖信息更新预计的里程碑日期。

dictation.label: 听写 1：未确认的外部交付
dictation.text: The API team has not confirmed its delivery date.

apply.prompt: 请用一句话提出当前可以先做一个粗略计划。
apply.sample: Let’s make a rough plan based on what we know.

dictation.label: 听写 2：拿到信息后更新里程碑
dictation.text: Once the API team confirms a date, we can update the milestone dates.

apply.prompt: 供应商的测试时间还不确定。请说明它是开放依赖。
apply.sample: Let’s mark vendor access as an open dependency.

translationPractice.prompt: 我们先根据目前掌握的信息做个粗略计划；这不是最终交付日期的承诺。
translationPractice.answer: Let’s make a rough plan based on what we know; it is not a firm delivery-date commitment.
translationPractice.why: 粗略计划用于启动讨论，不等于承诺最终日期。

translationPractice.prompt: 我们把 API 交付标记为尚未确定的依赖项。
translationPractice.answer: Let’s mark API delivery as an open dependency.
translationPractice.why: 开放依赖表示其时间或交付尚未确认。

translationPractice.prompt: API 团队确认日期后，我们就能更新里程碑日期。
translationPractice.answer: Once the API team confirms a date, we can update the milestone dates.
translationPractice.why: 时间信息明确后再更新里程碑。

choice.prompt: 外部 API 团队还未确认交付日期。哪句话能最清楚地把初步计划和最终里程碑区分开？
options: We have a plan, so the current milestone dates are now guaranteed.
Let’s make a rough plan based on what we know and mark API delivery as an open dependency. Once the API team confirms a date, we can update the milestone dates.
We cannot plan any work until the API team has finished.
choice.why: 来源把粗略计划定位为规划讨论的起点，并预期进度和范围会随项目推进调整；不应承诺未知日期，也不必因此停止所有已知工作。

output.prompt: 客户培训上线依赖供应商开放测试环境，对方还没有给日期。请用英文说明哪些工作可以先准备、标记哪项依赖，并说拿到时间后如何更新粗略里程碑。
output.sample: We can draft the training materials now and make a rough rollout plan, while marking vendor access as an open dependency. Once the vendor confirms the testing window, we can update the rollout milestones.
check: 是否说明目前可先准备培训材料？
是否将供应商测试环境标记为未确认依赖？
是否表明当前计划只是粗略安排？
是否说明收到供应商时间后更新里程碑？
